description: This file defines the interface IReader in the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifying methods and constants for reading spreadsheet files with configurable options.

classes.name: IReader
classes.description: Interface for reading spreadsheet files, providing methods for configuration and file loading.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Checks if the specified file can be read by the reader.

methods.name: getReadDataOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the reader is configured to read only data, excluding formatting and styling.

methods.name: setReadDataOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the reader should only read data, ignoring formatting and structures.

methods.name: getReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Returns whether the reader reads empty cells.

methods.name: setReadEmptyCells
methods.description: Configures whether the reader reads empty cells.

methods.name: getIncludeCharts
methods.description: Returns whether the reader includes charts in the reading process.

methods.name: setIncludeCharts
methods.description: Configures whether charts should be included.

methods.name: getLoadSheetsOnly
methods.description: Returns the sheets to be loaded or null for all sheets.

methods.name: setLoadAllSheets
methods.description: Configures the reader to load all sheets.

methods.name: setAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Enables or disables the allowance of external images.

methods.name: getAllowExternalImages
methods.description: Returns whether external images are allowed.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a spreadsheet file from disk with specified flags.
